newsitem.title: ZAMBIA: ZAMBIA STOCKS WEEK - ZAMBIA SUGAR LEADS TRADE.
newsitem.headline: ZAMBIA STOCKS WEEK - ZAMBIA SUGAR LEADS TRADE.

text.p: Traded volume rose on the Lusaka
stock exchange in the week ended April 18, exchange officials
said.
They said volume rose to 387,736 shares valued at 7.57
million kwacha from 40,112 shares valued at 1.65 million kwacha
the previous week.
Zambia Sugar remained steady at 16.75 kwacha in a traded
volume of 320,283 shares valued at 4,71 million kwacha.
Rothmans was steady at 39.5 kwacha and saw 2,500 shares
worth 98,750 kwacha changing hands.
Chilanga Cement rose from 69.5 kwacha to 71 kwacha and saw
35,576 shares valued at 2,487,170 kwacha.
Farmers House and Zambia Consolidated Copper Mines (ZCCM)
went untraded during the week.
Exchange officials said a Zambia Breweries plc offer opens
on April 21 at 150 kwacha ($0.12) per share. The offer size is
1.950 million kwacha ($1.5 million).
"The flotation is an offer for sale of 13 million shares by
the Zambias Privatisation Trust Fund on behalf of the
government," an official said.
Zambia Breweries is scheduled to be listed on the exchange
on June 6.
Bata Zambia held its annual general meeting on Friday and
approved a bonus share issue of one share for every four held
and a nominal dividend of 30 ngwee (US 0.023 cents)
per share to holders of record as at December 31, 1996.
Exchange officials said the company's turnover in 1996 was
6.26 million kwacha, up 40 percent from the previous year. Gross
profit rose by 41 percent to 2.57 million kwacha.
